# Chhath Ghat Online

> A free 3D Chhath Puja experience in the browser at https://chhath.klytos.co.in/ for people who can't go home for Chhath. Players live all four days of Chhath Puja 2026 on a virtual river ghat, with Sharda Sinha's Chhath geet playing.

## Chhath Puja 2026 dates
- Day 1, Nahay Khay: Friday 13 November 2026. Holy bath and one sattvik meal of kaddu-bhaat (bottle gourd, chana dal, rice with ghee and rock salt).
- Day 2, Kharna: Saturday 14 November 2026. Day-long fast broken at dusk with rasiya (jaggery kheer) and roti cooked on mango wood; the 36-hour nirjala fast begins.
- Day 3, Sandhya Arghya: Sunday 15 November 2026. Arghya to the setting sun; kosi bharai at night.
- Day 4, Usha Arghya and Paran: Monday 16 November 2026. Arghya to the rising sun, then the fast is broken.
- Shashthi tithi: 11:24 PM on 14 Nov to 2:01 AM on 16 Nov 2026.

## Arghya timings 2026 (approximate local sunset / sunrise)
- Patna: Sandhya Arghya 5:01 PM (15 Nov), Usha Arghya 6:07 AM (16 Nov)
- Delhi: 5:28 PM / 6:44 AM
- Mumbai: 6:00 PM / 6:46 AM

## What you can do on Chhath Ghat Online
- Play as a vratin (female) or vrati (male) and follow each day's rituals as tasks
- Take the holy dip, cook kaddu-bhaat, rasiya-kheer and thekua in a chulha mini-game
- Pack the daura with fruit, sugarcane and a bamboo soop, and offer arghya at sunset and sunrise
- Light a kosi, float diyas on the river, share prasad with neighbours
- Listen to Chhath geet: Kelwa Ke Paat Par, Pahile Pahil Chhathi Maiya, Ho Deenanath, Uthau Suruj Bhaile Bihaan, Kartik Mahinwan Ke, Ugihein Sooraj Gosaiyan Hey, Kaanch Hi Baans Ke Bahangiya
- Send Chhath wishes to family on WhatsApp
- Free, works on phone and computer, no sign-up

## About Chhath
Chhath is a four-day festival of thanks to Surya Dev (the Sun) and Chhathi Maiya, celebrated on Kartik Shukla Shashthi, six days after Diwali, mainly in Bihar, Jharkhand, eastern Uttar Pradesh and Nepal's Madhesh, and by the diaspora worldwide. It honours both the setting and the rising sun, with no priest or idol: the vratin offers arghya standing in water.
